summary: Iteration 108 - Backend regression test for sauna order margin double-counting fix in _recompute_one (routes/sauna_orders.py). Created 5 pytest cases covering: recompute-margins endpoint shape, variant.costPrice replaces (not adds to) model.costPrice when >0, variant.costPrice=0 falls back to model.costPrice, no-variant uses model.costPrice, and VAT-aware margin formula (netto = total/1.23 - totalCost - retailExtraCost). All 5/5 pass. Regression: iter 104-107 procurement+production suites = 26/29 pass; 3 failures are pre-existing PYTHONPATH issues unrelated to this fix.
critical_code_review_comments: _recompute_one in routes/sauna_orders.py is well-documented now (clear comment about why variant replaces, not augments). Logic mirrors the convention enforced by _sync_cost_price_to_sauna_prices (scope='variant' writes full cost).

Inconsistency with options block: at lines 467-487 for options with variants, the code already uses 'variant if present, else option' pattern (no addition). The model-level fix at 455-465 now matches that convention - good consistency.

Minor: retailExtra fallback uses `if v_extra > 0` semantics - so a variant deliberately setting retailExtra=0 cannot override a non-zero model retailExtra. Acceptable for current data but worth noting (same caveat applies to costPrice fallback).

routes/sauna_orders.py is 601 lines - still under the 700 guideline but creeping; consider isolating the margin/recompute block (~200 lines) into routes/sauna_orders_margin.py for future maintainability.

All assertions verified: variant_full_cost=7946 reproduces exactly (would have been 1000+7946=8946 with the old bug). Real-world parity with the user's screenshot (Wiking Lux z tarasem: 7946 zl now vs 18328 zl before).

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new fix coverage; 26/26 relevant regression - 3 collection failures are pre-existing PYTHONPATH bugs in iter 106-107 test files)

seed_data_creation: Injected TEST_MODEL_ITER108 with TEST_VARIANT_FULL_ITER108 (costPrice=7946, retailExtraCost=500) and TEST_VARIANT_ZERO_ITER108 (costPrice=0) into sauna_prices.default via Mongo $push. Created 4 test orders (id prefix WMS-TEST-*) via /api/sauna/orders. Module-scoped autouse fixture purges TEST_ model from sauna_prices and TEST_ orders from sauna_orders on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two reusable patterns from this iteration: (1) Use MongoClient + $push/$pull on sauna_prices.default to inject test models/variants without disturbing POST /api/sauna/prices replace-all semantics. (2) `_load_env_file` helper at top of test file - older test files (test_procurement_stock_delivery.py, test_production_stock_deduction.py) hard-fail on `assert BASE_URL` if pytest is launched without env loaded; main agent should consider migrating them to the same _load_env_file pattern. The 3 unrelated regression failures (test_telegram_format_multiline_unchanged, test_deduct_lowers_stock_and_writes_audit, test_revert_restores_stock_and_writes_in_audit) are ALL `ModuleNotFoundError: routes/database` from `from routes... import` / `from database import db` inside tests that need PYTHONPATH=/app/backend - they would pass if launched as `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/...`.
rca of the issue: Bug: _recompute_one previously did `total_cost = model_cost + variant_cost + opts_cost`, but _sync_cost_price_to_sauna_prices(scope='variant') in routes/sauna_tech_cards.py writes the FULL build cost into variant.costPrice (not a delta). So orders showed model+variant double-cost (e.g. Wiking Lux: 1000+7946=18328 instead of 7946). Fix verified: line 455-465 now does `if v_cost > 0: model_cost = v_cost` (replace, not add). retailExtraCost has identical treatment. Tests reproduce the exact scenario from the user's screenshot and confirm marginCost = variant.costPrice (NOT model + variant). Fallback path (variant.costPrice=0) and no-variant path preserved.
